hook.name: PairPadMemeHook
hook.description: Singleton fee-collection hook for graduated PairPad meme token pools. Takes a configurable fee (hookFeeBps + creatorTaxBps) from the unspecified currency on every swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, accumulating fees in pending balances. Fees are later converted memecoin-to-quote via internal pool swaps and distributed to protocol, creator, and an optional buyback-and-lock vault.
